description: This file defines the TestClusterHostFactory class which provides static methods to create and configure Orleans test cluster silos and clients, serialize/deserialize configurations, and set up related services and logging.

classes.name: TestClusterHostFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create and configure Orleans test silos and clients, serialize configurations, and set up related services.

methods.name: CreateSiloHost
methods.description: Creates and configures a new Orleans silo host with specified configuration and optional post-configuration.

methods.name: CreateClusterClient
methods.description: Creates and configures a new Orleans cluster client host with specified configuration and optional post-configuration.

methods.name: SerializeConfiguration
methods.description: Serializes an IConfiguration object into a JSON string.

methods.name: DeserializeConfiguration
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string into an IConfiguration object.

methods.name: ConfigureAppServices
methods.description: Configures silo builder with configurator types specified in configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureClientAppServices
methods.description: Configures client builder with configurator types specified in configuration.

methods.name: TryConfigureFileLogging
methods.description: Sets up file logging if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: InitializeTestHooksSystemTarget
methods.description: Initializes the TestHooksSystemTarget service within the host.
